methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 high-search instant-print camera models spanning analog film, hybrid digital/film, and ZINK digital-print categories as of mid-2026, including current-generation Fujifilm Instax, Polaroid, Kodak, and Canon lines. Primary sources are manufacturer specification pages (fujifilm.com, instaxus.com, polaroid.com, i2-camera.polaroid.com, press.polaroid.com, kodakphotoplus.com, usa.canon.com) and official press/newsroom releases; prices were cross-checked against major US retailers (Best Buy, B&H Photo, Amazon, Walmart, Target) and deal-tracker sites in June 2026. Booleans (true/false) indicate confirmed feature presence or absence; null means not verifiable from consulted sources. Weight is in ounces (oz), rounded to one decimal. Adversarial re-verification June 19 2026: all 13 draft models confirmed real and independently corroborated; no fabrications removed. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.provenance: Re-verified June 2026. MSRP $93.95 confirmed via instaxus.com; runs on 2x AA alkaline (not rechargeable). Released March 2023 per Fujifilm global announcement.

products.name: Fujifilm Instax Mini 99
products.provenance: Re-verified June 2026. MSRP $199.95 confirmed (TechRadar/Amazon); announced March 2024, available mid-April 2024. Weight 305 g (10.8 oz). Rechargeable NP-70S battery and ~10-second self-timer confirmed. No selfie mirror (reviewers note its absence; selfie via macro/twist-lens mode only).

products.name: Fujifilm Instax Wide 400
products.priceNote: Current US retail price; launch MSRP was $149.95

Self-timer and included close-up lens with integrated selfie mirror confirmed. Launch MSRP $149.95 (late June 2024); current US retail $174.95 in 2026 (also matches new jet-black variant) per Best Buy/Amazon/PetaPixel.

products.name: Fujifilm Instax Square SQ40
products.provenance: Re-verified June 2026. MSRP $149.95; announced June 29 2023, available end of June 2023. Weight 453 g (16.0 oz). Uses 2x CR2 lithium (not rechargeable). Selfie mirror plus dedicated Selfie Mode confirmed. No self-timer in official specs (false).

products.name: Fujifilm Instax Mini Evo
products.priceNote: Current MSRP per instaxus.com; launch MSRP was $199.95
products.provenance: Re-verified June 2026. Weight 285 g (10.1 oz). 3.0-inch TFT LCD, internal rechargeable Li-ion, selfie mirror, 2/10-second self-timer. Hybrid digital (built-in instax mini printer). US launch Feb 2022 at $199.95; current MSRP $234.95 confirmed on instaxus.com. (Note: this is the standard Mini Evo, distinct from the new 2026 Mini Evo Cinema at $409.95.)
